documented_contradictions.subject: core slab concrete type
documented_contradictions.treatment: V8I does not use concrete tensile stiffness; the contradiction therefore affects omitted mass/compression behavior, not the cracked-reinforcement catenary law.

model_assumptions.topology: nearest-four connected proxy inherited from V8H; not the as-built beam/slab mesh
model_assumptions.core_area: convex hull of reconstructed core column centrelines; floor openings and slab beyond the column-centre hull are not explicitly meshed
model_assumptions.strip_width: one isotropic network is area-normalized so sum(edge length times effective width) equals twice the active convex-hull area, representing two reinforcement directions without assigning a real strip to any edge
model_assumptions.slab_mechanism: cracked reinforcement-only catenary in parallel with the V8H bilinear beam spring; concrete tensile resistance is set to zero
model_assumptions.slab_temperature: either 20 C as an optimistic upper bound or the mean synthetic temperature of the edge endpoint columns as a proxy
model_assumptions.beam_case: 14WF136 proxy, connection factor 1.0, two active floor planes, endpoint-mean temperature; chosen before V8I execution as the middle V8H section with optimistic connection participation
model_assumptions.vertical_coupling: stable column reactions at one story become nodal loads at the story below

slab_cases.interpretation: V8H beam-only reference on the selected topology and beam case
lower sensitivity envelope: low documented directional ratio, reduced active area, lower assumed yield and ductility
low documented directional ratio over the full area proxy
high documented directional ratio but only one quarter of the convex-hull area active
strong documented directional ratio over the full area proxy
deliberately optimistic upper envelope: full proxy area, high ratio, cold reinforcement and high assumed ductility

omitted: as-built slab reinforcement and opening geometry
concrete compression, cracking and aggregate interlock

ensemble_definition.column_damage_rule: NIST Case B more-severe impact state; severed and heavy segments removed only on reported floors
ensemble_definition.warning: Every synthetic field spans the NIST floor minimum and maximum. Fractions measure robustness to these constructed fields, not event probabilities.
